aj: tiny nit — some of these are anchor drift, not hard 404s. suggest using this one-liner to rename anchors and add redirects where needed:
```
# rename anchor tokens in files and add redirect entries (example)
rg "#prefetch" -n docs/ | cut -d: -f1 | xargs -I {} sed -i 's/#prefetch/#prefetch-usage/g' {}
# then append redirect mapping for old -> new in redirects.yaml
```

maria: heads-up: i'll grep product repos for inlined links after the PR lands. changing anchors without redirects can break sdk examples.

sara: noted. will add redirect entries for anything referenced in code. opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4012 :thumbsup:
